note: Per-PR JS bundle-size budget for the Android Metro export, in BYTES. Enforced by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs in the ci.yml 'mobile-bundle-size' job. A value of 0 (or an absent key) means REPORT-ONLY: the guardrail measures and prints but never fails, so the machinery is safe before it is calibrated. The orchestrator sets these two numbers from a real `expo export` measurement (see docs/APP-SIZE.md 'How to measure locally'). DoorDash app-size discipline: growth must be INTENTIONAL. If a PR legitimately pushes a bundle past budget, RAISE the offending number here IN THE SAME PR and justify it in one sentence in the PR description — never bump it in a follow-up. See docs/APP-SIZE.md. RESET 2026-10-02 (trim first, then reset): after the bundle trim the measured export total is 7,571,670 B and the Hermes bundle 7,210,515 B; each budget is that measurement plus ~60 KB of headroom for the features landing in parallel. Every raise gets a row in docs/APP-SIZE.md Budget history.
